title: Moroccan Almond and Date Cookies
summary: Soft, fragrant cookies with a sweet date filling and a lightly spiced almond dough. They’re a lovely dessert with tea or coffee, especially warm from the oven.
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line two baking trays with baking paper.

Make the filling by gently warming the chopped dates with the water in a small pan for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring until the dates soften into a thick paste. Stir in the chopped almonds, then set aside to cool.
In a bowl, mix the flour, ground almonds, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt.
In a separate large bowl, beat the butter and sugar until pale and fluffy. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
Add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture and mix until a soft dough forms. If it feels very sticky, chill it for 10 minutes.
Divide the dough into 12 pieces. Flatten each piece, place a small spoonful of date filling in the centre, then wrap the dough around it and roll into a ball.
Arrange the cookies on the trays, leaving space between them, and flatten them slightly with your fingers or the palm of your hand.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the cookies are lightly golden at the edges but still soft in the centre.
Leave to cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
